about: Ad Shield's own scriptlet rules (MIT). Each rule: hosts (each covers its subdomains) and scriptlets ([name, ...string args]) from src/scriptlets/lib.js. Built into build/scriptlets-main.js by tools/build.py; shipped in the package, never downloaded. Object paths and URL patterns: docs/research-v2.md section B. The YouTube anti-adblock dialog is closed by youtube-enforcement-dismiss, not hidden by CSS (hiding kept its scroll lock and pauses).

rules.about: Ad data removed before the player sees it: the page-embedded player response and initial data (setter traps), every JSON.parse / Response.json (player keys always; feed and Shorts ad items only in API responses, which have responseContext), and the youtubei fetch / XHR responses. Plus the onAbnormalityDetected reporter defused the web_streaming_watch flag off (research B recipe 1-7), and the 17 s "fake buffering" wait of flagged accounts (a native-code callback scheduled with setTimeout 17000) cut to 17 ms (research B section 1).

rules.about: Fallbacks: for ads that still play (e.g. server-side inserted) mute, jump to the end of the ad, click Skip, unmute afterwards (research B recipe 11); and close YouTube's anti-adblock dialog properly (close() releases its scroll lock and backdrop) and resume a video it paused without the viewer (B.3); pauses from media keys, headphones or picture-in-picture (media session actions) are left alone.
